mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, channel, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM notification_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY channel, type

SELECT np.id, np.user_id, np.type, np.channel, np.enabled, np.created_at, np.updated_at FROM notification_preference np JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = np.user_id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND np.channel = #{channel} ORDER BY np.user_id, np.type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_preference (user_id, type, channel, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{channel}, #{enabled}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = incoming.enabled
